items.title: The blowing up induces a bijection on the generic points outside the center
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X with blowing up b : X' -> X, the map b induces a bijection from the generic points of irreducible components of X' to the generic points of irreducible components of X that do not lie in Z (source lines 8540-8547). The proof reduces to the statement that for an effective Cartier divisor D in a scheme S no generic point of an irreducible component of S lies in D: it replaces S by an affine cover, writes D = V(f) with f a nonzerodivisor, and derives a contradiction from f lying in a minimal prime by the corresponding algebra lemma.
